title: The System Hallucination Scale (SHS): A Human-Centered Instrument for Assessing Perceived Reliability of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.09989v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models routinely produce factually incorrect or misleading outputs, yet conventional automated benchmarks overlook how users perceive reliability during interaction. We introduce the System Hallucination Scale (SHS), a lightweight instrument modeling the famous System Usability Scale (SUS) and System Causability Scales (SCS). SHS measures perceived reliability across five dimensions: factual accuracy, source reliability, logical coherence, deceptiveness of presentation, and responsiveness to user guidance, using ten balanced Likert-scale items that provide a directional score and consistency diagnostic. In a supervised validation study with 193 participants (386 evaluations across 47 trained experimenters), SHS demonstrated strong internal consistency and high clarity, completing in an average of 4.2 minutes. translated_title: 系统幻觉量表（SHS）：一种评估大语言模型感知可靠性的人本化工具
translated_abstract: 大语言模型经常产生事实错误或具有误导性的输出，然而传统的自动化基准测试忽视了用户在交互过程中如何感知模型的可靠性。我们提出了系统幻觉量表（SHS），这是一种借鉴著名的系统可用性量表（SUS）和系统可归因性量表（SCS）而设计的轻量级评估工具。SHS从五个维度衡量感知可靠性：事实准确性、来源可靠性、逻辑连贯性、表述的欺骗性以及对用户引导的响应性，采用十个平衡的李克特量表条目，可提供方向性得分和一致性诊断。在一项由193名参与者（47名经过培训的实验员完成386次评估）参与的监督验证研究中，SHS展现出良好的内部一致性和高清晰度，平均完成时间仅为4.2分钟。参与者对来源可验证性和表述欺骗性的评价低于事实准确性，表……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 论文提出了一种借鉴SUS量表设计的轻量级人本化问卷工具——系统幻觉量表（SHS），通过十个李克特量表条目从事实准确性、来源可靠性等五个维度评估用户对大语言模型可靠性的感知，并在193名参与者的验证研究中证实了其良好的信效度和约4.2分钟的快速完成特性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the System Hallucination Scale (SHS), a lightweight human-centered instrument modeled on the SUS, which uses ten balanced Likert-scale items across five dimensions to assess users' perceived reliability of large language models, validated with strong internal consistency and an average 4.2-minute completion time in a study of 193 participants.
